thread:
alex: morning — p95 spikes for many short requests. pprof shows host tokenize -> parse_frame -> coalesce -> grpc_writev heavy.

alex: flame: https://perf.internal/pprof?run=3417700000

priya: isn't this after kernel-affinity change routing <128 tokens to slim kernels?

jamie: reproduced w/ shortbench --seq=48 --rps=600. small batches thrash KV shards and grpc writev count jumps.

jamie: quick numbers:
batch_floor=2 -> p95=50ms, kv_evictions/s=200, writev/s=700
batch_floor=12 -> p95=29ms, kv_evictions/s=20, writev/s=180

maria: likely two causes: batching floor too low + frame coalescing disabled on micro kernels.

liam: mitigation: canary (5%) -> batch_floor=8 for short flows, enable proxy writev_coalesce for payloads<256, add metrics: per-shard kv_eviction, grpc_writev_count, parse_coalesce_ms.

deploy-bot: @alex created canary deploy service=host-ingress group=shortflow-mitigations percent=5

alex: actions — jamie instrument parse_coalesce_ms (30m), priya add dashboards & trace header (20m), liam flip writev_coalesce on canary, maria run replay and post results.

alex: watching canary; call out p99/cpu/errors.
